blurb: Varieties, ideals and the Nullstellensatz, projective curves, Bézout's theorem, elliptic curves, genus and schemes.

pics.alt: Four panels showing the chord-and-tangent group law on a real elliptic curve
pics.caption: The group law on an elliptic curve: three collinear points P, Q, R sum to the identity 0, the point at infinity. The other panels show the tangent case, a vertical line through P and −P, and a point of order 2 with a vertical tangent.
pics.title: ECClines.svg

pics.alt: Black-and-white studio portrait of Emmy Noether as a young woman
pics.caption: Emmy Noether (1882–1935), photographed around 1900. Her 1921 theory of ideals in rings satisfying the ascending chain condition, now called Noetherian rings, is the algebraic foundation of modern algebraic geometry.
pics.title: Noether.jpg
